en.headline: Hong Kong Airlines cancels two Okinawa flights today as Typhoon Champi nears
en.dek: The carrier has axed HX658 and HX659 between Hong Kong and Okinawa on Thursday and warned that Taipei services may face delays or cancellations through Saturday.
body: Hong Kong Airlines said it has cancelled two flights between Hong Kong and Okinawa scheduled for Thursday because of Super Typhoon Champi.

The cancelled services are HX658 from Hong Kong to Okinawa and HX659 from Okinawa to Hong Kong. The airline has waived rebooking, destination-change and refund fees for passengers with confirmed seats on the affected flights.
Eligible passengers can apply through the special ticketing arrangements page on the airline’s website. Those who booked through a travel agent or package tour should contact their agent directly.

Hong Kong Airlines also said flights between Hong Kong and Taipei were still operating normally on Wednesday evening, but services from Thursday through Saturday could be delayed or cancelled as the typhoon moves closer to Taiwan. Passengers were advised to check flight status before heading to the airport.

zh.headline: 港航取消今日兩班沖繩航班 薔琶影響台北航線或受阻
zh.dek: 香港航空宣布取消周四往返香港與沖繩的HX658及HX659，並指明日起至周六往返台北航班可能延誤或取消。
body: 香港航空表示，受超強颱風薔琶影響，已取消周四兩班往返香港與沖繩的航班。
被取消的是由香港飛往沖繩的HX658，以及由沖繩飛往香港的HX659。港航已豁免受影響航班重新訂位、更改航點及退票的手續費用，適用於已獲確認機位的機票。
合資格乘客可透過港航官方網站的特別票務安排申請。經旅行社或旅行團訂票的乘客，則需直接聯絡相關旅行社查詢安排。
港航又指，周三晚上往返香港與台北的航班仍維持正常，但預料周四至周六的服務可能受延誤或取消。公司呼籲旅客出發前往機場前，先查閱官網的航班狀態。
